title: The Penance Wheel
text: A wheel stands in the court's square, taller than a man and stained dark at the rim. The court ties a penitent to it, and anyone may spin it, for luck. Today's penitent hangs upside down and weeps without sound. The crowd waits to see who spins first.

outcomes.text: The crowd boos, then stops booing and reaches for knives. The penitent blesses you as you fight.

options.label: The Leader spins the wheel, as the custom asks.

outcomes.text: Luck, of a kind, and his screams for every turn of it.

options.label: The sharpest eye watches the crowd instead.

outcomes.text: You learn who rules here, and who wants to.
